The @riversideartandmusicfestival is a free, family-friendly celebration of arts, culture, and community. This annual event features live music, art installations, workshops, local artist vendors, and performances that showcase the creativity and talent of Riverside. 

Use your FREE @riversidetransit U-PASS to get there!🚍✨

Follow  @riversideartscouncil & @riversideartandmusicfestival to learn more! 

Visit transportation.ucr.edu/campus-bus-routes for the RTA Route 1 bus map and schedule. 

Use the @transit.app mobile app to follow bus arrival times in real time. 

#ucr #riverisdeartandmusicfestival #ucrarts

texts.caption:
What happens when you embrace the unexpected?

Inspired by Dispatches: The Photography of Douglas McCulloh, 1990–2025, join us for Chance Encounters: College Night—an evening of art, music, making, and creative experimentation for all college students (UCR and other colleges!).

Explore the galleries, groove to music by DJ Devyn Dezray, grab some matcha and snacks in the college lounge (with college ID), and get hands-on with creative activities including surrealist zine-making, button making, bedazzling everyday objects, and a whimsy maxxing station for maximum chaotic joy

Come curious. Make something weird. See where chance takes you.

DJ Devyn Dezray
Art-making + creative activities
Open galleries
Matcha + snacks (until supplies run out!)

🗓️ October 1, 2026
⏰ 6-9 p.m.
🆓 Free event for all college students!
🔗 Learn more by visiting the link in bio!
